zh.title: 美國航空將開放頭等艙專屬貴賓餐飲區給商務艙旅客
zh.summary: 美國航空宣布開放頭等艙用餐區給商務艙旅客；同步推動全美貴賓室升級計劃。
body: 根據媒體 Simple Flying 報導，美國航空（American Airlines）計畫開放其原先專屬的頭等艙餐飲貴賓室（First Class Dining Rooms）給商務艙搭乘旅客使用。該措施將讓更多搭乘商務艙的旅客能夠進入體驗原本僅限頭等艙使用的餐飲服務區域。
此項服務調整屬於美國航空在美國全境推行貴賓室升級措施的一環。隨著相關升級計畫在全美各地持續推進，航空公司期望藉由擴大貴賓室開放範疇與提升設施品質，為更多飛行旅客提供更為完善的地面貴賓服務體驗。

en.title: American Airlines To Open First Class Dining Rooms To Business Class Passengers
en.summary: American Airlines will open its First Class dining rooms to Business Class passengers during lounge upgrades.
body: American Airlines will open its exclusive First Class dining rooms to Business Class passengers, according to a report by Simple Flying. The policy change will expand access to the carrier's premium dining areas for a broader group of premium flyers.
The decision to grant Business Class passengers access to First Class dining facilities comes as American Airlines rolls out lounge upgrades across airports in the United States.
As part of the nationwide lounge initiative, American Airlines is opening these dining doors to more flyers while implementing general facility enhancements throughout its US lounge network.

zh.title: 達美航空飛羅馬A330客機因機械緊急狀況改降加拿大
zh.summary: 達美航空載有280人的客機因機械緊急狀況在加拿大紐芬蘭降落。
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 報導，達美航空一架飛往羅馬的空中巴士 A330 客機在載有 280 人的情況下，因遭遇「機械緊急狀況」而被迫改飛加拿大。當地緊急救援人員在客機降落加拿大紐芬蘭時於現場待命。隨後，達美航空安排了一架替代飛機，將所有受影響的乘客送回紐約。
此外，根據本站歷史資料顯示，達美航空先前於2026年8月16日宣布，其新型空中巴士 A330-900neo 客機將配備 56 個達美至臻商務艙（Delta One）套房。該航空公司引進此高比例商務艙的佈局，旨在服務其頂級跨大西洋航線。

en.title: Rome-Bound Delta Airbus A330 Diverts To Canada Due To Mechanical Emergency
en.summary: Delta Airbus A330 bound for Rome diverts to Canada following a mechanical emergency.
body: According to an aviation news report by Simple Flying, a Rome-bound Delta Airbus A330 with 280 people onboard was forced to divert to Canada following a "mechanical emergency." Local emergency response crews met the aircraft upon its unscheduled landing in Newfoundland. To assist the stranded travelers, Delta subsequently dispatched a replacement aircraft to ferry all passengers back to New York.

As historical background from our database, Delta announced on August 16, 2026, that its incoming Airbus A330-900neo fleet will be configured with 56 Delta One suites. The airline is introducing this premium-heavy layout specifically to serve its top transatlantic flight routes.
